nodes.description: ERC20Basic.totalSupply: public total token supply, set once in Coingecko constructor.
BasicToken.balances: mapping(address => uint256) holding per-account token balances.
StandardToken.allowed: nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) of spend allowances.
Coingecko.name: constant token name 'coingecko.com'.
Coingecko.symbol: constant token symbol 'EDM'.
Coingecko.decimals: constant 18 decimals used in supply math.
Coingecko.INITIAL_SUPPLY: constant 90000 * 10**decimals minted at deployment.
SafeMath.mul: guarded multiplication with overflow assertion.
SafeMath.div: division with implicit revert on divide-by-zero.
SafeMath.sub: subtraction asserting b <= a to prevent underflow.
SafeMath.add: addition asserting c >= a to prevent overflow.
SafeMath.toUINT112: checked narrowing cast to uint112.
SafeMath.toUINT120: checked narrowing cast to uint120.
SafeMath.toUINT128: checked narrowing cast to uint128.
BasicToken.transfer: moves tokens from msg.sender to _to, updating balances.
BasicToken.balanceOf: constant view returning balances[_owner].
StandardToken.transferFrom: moves tokens using balances and allowed allowance checks.
StandardToken.approve: sets/overwrites allowance with zero-first guard.
StandardToken.allowance: constant view returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Coingecko constructor: mints INITIAL_SUPPLY to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
msg.sender: attacker-controllable caller address used for ownership of balances and allowances.
State write balances[msg.sender] = balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) inside transfer.
State write balances[_to] = balances[_to].add(_value) inside transfer.
State write balances[_from] = balances[_from].sub(_value) inside transferFrom.
State write balances[_to] = balances[_to].add(_value) inside transferFrom.
State write allowed[_from][msg.sender] decremented in transferFrom.
State write allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value inside approve.
Constructor state writes: totalSupply and balances[msg.sender] set to INITIAL_SUPPLY.
BasicToken.transfer parameter _to: recipient address.
BasicToken.transfer parameter _value: amount transferred.
BasicToken.balanceOf parameter _owner: queried address.
StandardToken.transferFrom parameter _from: debited source address.
StandardToken.transferFrom parameter _to: credited destination address.
StandardToken.transferFrom parameter _value: amount moved.
StandardToken.approve parameter _spender: address granted allowance.
StandardToken.approve parameter _value: allowance amount set.
StandardToken.allowance parameter _owner: allowance owner.
StandardToken.allowance parameter _spender: allowance spender.

edges.reason: transfer executes the sender balance debit.
transfer executes the recipient balance credit.
transfer calls SafeMath.sub for the sender debit.
transfer calls SafeMath.add for the recipient credit.
msg.sender indexes the storage slot being debited.
msg.sender is emitted as the from address of the Transfer event.
msg.sender keys the allowance mapping written in approve.
constructor credits the entire supply to msg.sender.
_value is subtracted from the sender balance.
_value is added to the recipient balance.
_to indexes the recipient balance credited in transfer.
balances mapping is read then written during the sender debit.
balances mapping is read then written during the recipient credit.
transferFrom executes the _from balance debit.
transferFrom executes the _to balance credit.
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub on balances and allowance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add on the recipient balance.
_from indexes the balance being debited.
_from is the outer key of the allowance mapping decremented.
_to indexes the balance being credited.
_value is subtracted from balances[_from].
_value is added to balances[_to].
_value is subtracted from the spender allowance.
msg.sender is the inner key of the allowance being spent.
allowed mapping is read for the spend check and rewritten after the transfer.
balances[_from] is read, verified and decremented.
balances[_to] is incremented in transferFrom.
approve writes the new allowance value.
allowed mapping is overwritten by approve.
_spender keys the allowance entry written in approve.
_value is the allowance amount stored in approve.
constructor performs the initial supply state writes.
INITIAL_SUPPLY is the value assigned to totalSupply and balances.
totalSupply is written with INITIAL_SUPPLY during deployment.
balances[msg.sender] is written with INITIAL_SUPPLY during deployment.
decimals is used in the 10**decimals supply computation.
balanceOf reads values from the balances mapping.
_owner is the lookup key used by balanceOf.
_owner is the outer key read by allowance.
_spender is the inner key read by allowance.
allowance returns allowed[_owner][_spender].
add is part of the SafeMath arithmetic family used for balance updates.
sub and div are sibling SafeMath arithmetic helpers.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to is only meaningful as the recipient argument of transfer.
Parameter _value belongs to the transfer balance update logic.
Parameter _owner is the sole lookup argument of balanceOf.
Parameter _from is the debit source of transferFrom.
Parameter _to is the credit destination of transferFrom.
Parameter _value directly determines the balance and allowance arithmetic performed by transferFrom.
Parameter _spender is the allowance key written by approve.
Parameter _value is the exact allowance amount stored by approve.
Parameter _owner is the outer allowance lookup key.
Parameter _spender is the inner allowance lookup key.
